digest.component_or_area: documentation generation and config schema reference
propositions: A new generator script must produce config-reference.md and security.md from config schema, deprecation registry, and secret-name inventory without modifying the existing config.md
Generated docs must carry a banner naming the generator command within the first 8 lines and be registered in test_generated_surface_markers.py and docs/README.md
The generator must support a --check mode that detects drift using newline-normalized comparison and returns nonzero on stale docs

Generated docs must include anchors for all required topics: precedence, source, lifecycle, restart/redeploy rotation, native refresh, observability exception, subprocess limitations, behavior deltas, and MCP/CLI exposure
All existing consumers of docs/config.md (content-asserting tests and deep-link anchors) must remain functional and unchanged
